cc:Work.dc:title: United Wholesale Mortgage application outcomes, 2007–2016
cc:Work.dc:description: Local HMDA records, action_taken 1–5. Counts in thousands; percentages of total applications. Historical reporting entity linked by tax ID 38-2750395, including Shore Mortgage and United Shore filings; not an isolated wholesale channel. Positive counts below 100 display as <0.1. Horizontal scales differ between periods.
